statements:
SELECT uaw_records.principal_id, uaw_records.namespace, uaw_records.resource_id, uaw_records.revision, uaw_records.schema_name, uaw_records.payload, uaw_records.deleted, uaw_records.updated_at 
FROM uaw_records 
WHERE uaw_records.principal_id = %(pk_1)s::VARCHAR AND uaw_records.namespace = %(pk_2)s::VARCHAR AND uaw_records.resource_id = %(pk_3)s::VARCHAR

SELECT max(uaw_outbox.seq) AS max_1 
FROM uaw_outbox 
WHERE uaw_outbox.principal_id = %(principal_id_1)s::VARCHAR AND uaw_outbox.stream_id = %(stream_id_1)s::VARCHAR

SELECT uaw_outbox.event_id, uaw_outbox.principal_id, uaw_outbox.stream_id, uaw_outbox.seq, uaw_outbox.event_type, uaw_outbox.payload, uaw_outbox.created_at 
FROM uaw_outbox 
WHERE uaw_outbox.principal_id = %(principal_id_1)s::VARCHAR AND uaw_outbox.stream_id = %(stream_id_1)s::VARCHAR AND uaw_outbox.seq <= %(seq_1)s::BIGINT AND uaw_outbox.seq > %(seq_2)s::BIGINT ORDER BY uaw_outbox.seq 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER

SELECT uaw_records.principal_id, uaw_records.namespace, uaw_records.resource_id, uaw_records.revision, uaw_records.schema_name, uaw_records.payload, uaw_records.deleted, uaw_records.updated_at 
FROM uaw_records 
WHERE uaw_records.principal_id = %(principal_id_1)s::VARCHAR AND uaw_records.namespace = %(namespace_1)s::VARCHAR AND uaw_records.resource_id IN (%(resource_id_1_1)s::VARCHAR, %(resource_id_1_2)s::VARCHAR, %(resource_id_1_3)s::VARCHAR, %(resource_id_1_4)s::VARCHAR, %(resource_id_1_5)s::VARCHAR, %(resource_id_1_6)s::VARCHAR, %(resource_id_1_7)s::VARCHAR) AND uaw_records.deleted IS false
